notes.title: Crash fix
notes.content: - Fixed a crash when raining and entering an inside level and then exiting outside again (rain SFX null pointer).

notes.title: Crash fixes + more Steam Deck support
notes.content:
- Crash fixes
- Steam deck specific strings and gamepad icons

notes.title: Critical crash fix
notes.content: - Dangling pointer issue resolved. Objects could be added to deletion queue more than once.

notes.title: Main menu showstopper bug fix
notes.content: - Fixed a bug on the main menu where debug buttons were being processed invisibly. This could lead to a player getting stuck and needing to force quit.

notes.title: 1.01 patch
notes.content:
- Reduced volume of deflect "ping" sound
- Reduced volume of bomb explosions
- Bombs are now thrown with L3 so you can aim with the right stick

Thanks everyone.
